The ClientHello cut in observe only and with no tunnel loaded, and checks every 10 seconds.

To update, run the new `dpiswitch.exe` from anywhere and accept the offer to install over the installed version (one administrator prompt). Settings, lists, configs and verdicts are kept.

## DPI bypass

- **Observe only cuts everything at once** when Settings → DPI bypass → Cut the ClientHello is on. Its catch-all goes direct through the cut instead of as it is: a name not checked yet works at once rather than hanging until the detector gets to it -- Instagram alone opens dozens. The names the detector found clean without the cut go direct as they are, above it.
- **With no first tunnel loaded** the cut is checked too, if switched on; before, the detector checked nothing without awg1. A site is tried direct as it is and, cut on its ClientHello, direct with the cut on the same node: CLEAN_SPLIT only when the cut gets a certificate that passes the chain check and an answer. Speed is not compared, there is nothing to compare against. Such verdicts are marked and are the first checked again once awg1 is loaded.
- Tunnel only sends nothing direct, the cut included; the settings say so beside the switch.

## Detector

- **Checks every 10 seconds instead of every minute, 8 at once instead of 4:** a new name waits seconds for its check, not minutes.
